mapper.sql: id, menu_parent_id, menu_name, menu_path, menu_component, menu_icon, menu_type, menu_sort, visible, menu_status, delete_flag, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_menu_permission mp ON m.id = mp.menu_id AND mp.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON mp.permission_id = p.id AND p.delete_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.menu_parent_id, m.menu_sort
